answer_1.quote: Neural machine translation (NMT) models have achieved remarkable performance since introduced encoder-decoder architecture with self-and cross-attention mechanisms.

answer_2.quote: Our method is validated with WMT and IWSLT benchmarks with diverse language pairs and shows consistent improvements in COMET, a pretrained neural network based evaluation framework that reportedly correlates highly with human evaluation, as well as the widely-used BLEU scores.
